This allows overlapping computation of scaling operations during the scatter phase and enables potential pipelining of communication with next-stage preparation. Trades dispatch count for smaller per-dispatch payload and potential latency hiding.

strategies.name: Fused Multi-Stage Buffering with Delayed Synchronization

Reduces synchronization points from 8 to 2-4 collective dispatch groups by amortizing host-device round-trips, trading memory footprint for lower dispatch overhead.

Uses approximately 2×8=16 dispatches (intra+inter per stage) but with smaller payloads and potential for node-local memory optimization, representing a topology-aware communication pattern.
